# Artifact index

## Registers

| File | Rows | Records |
|---|---:|---|
| `provenance/ship-ledger.csv` | 303 | every upstream file, its verdict, and why |
| `provenance/package-file-origins.csv` | 265 | shipped file → upstream path, size, uncompressed digest |
| `provenance/release-files.csv` | 412 | exact public file set, class, and governing licence |
| `provenance/shared-harness-files.csv` | 14 | reviewed cross-package base set and SHA-256 |
| `provenance/runnable-code.csv` | 36 | exact executable audit surface |
| `provenance/reproduction-map.csv` | 16 | exhibit → generator → inputs → parity method |
| `provenance/manuscript-artifact-contract.csv` | 16 | exhibit → printed label → claim |
| `provenance/chart-specs.csv` | 9 | each figure panel's mapping and direction claim |
| `provenance/excluded-digests.csv` | 39 | what was excluded, with a reason — including the SWMDK object and Phase 16 bundle digests |
| `provenance/redactions.csv` | 10 | every file modified before shipping, with both digests |
| `provenance/governance/DIGESTS.csv` | 17 | governance files with their SHA-256 |
| `reference-code/ARCHIVAL-DIGESTS.csv` | 21 | archival vs shipped digest per reference file |
| `verification/expected/exhibit-parity.csv` | 15 | the parity target, from the published build |

Digests of record are of **uncompressed** content.

## Layout

```
├── 00_setup.R                environment check; installs nothing
├── config.yml                tiers, counts, gates, the SWMDK lock
├── common/R/paths.R, io.R    the only location resolver; typed readers
├── data-frozen/              28 MB — see CODEBOOK.md
│   ├── design/               estimand contract, weight law, Phase 14/15 designs
│   ├── pilot/ development/ validation/
│   ├── confirmatory/         Phase 16, locked
│   ├── confirmatory-raw/     86,400 replication rows, gzipped
│   ├── empirical/            12 x 99,999 draws + artifacts + results
│   └── phase18/              the G18-A crosswalk and G18-B integration
├── exhibits/                 the runnable layer
├── outputs/                  7 figures, 8 floats, the 144-key ledger
├── reference-code/           the pipeline, annotated, NEVER sourced
├── provenance/               boundary, governance, the registers
├── verification/             the gates, their controls, and the oracles
└── docs/                     this guide
```

## Three conventions

**Absolute paths live in one file** — `common/R/paths.R`, which contains none
itself.

**`reference-code/` is never sourced or executed by the registered runnable
layer.** Verification may read it as text/data to check digests, banners, and
the archival-safety certificate. `verification/verify_quarantine.py` audits the
source/import/subprocess boundary, and a cold build is rehearsed with the whole
directory unavailable.

**The runnable build does not depend on the companion paper's research tree.**
The copied receipts and archival evidence legitimately retain those provenance
strings; they are outside this narrower execution claim. The exact public file
set is checked against `provenance/release-files.csv`.
